verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a hosted monitoring SaaS like Sentry, but the evidence pack never documents configurable retention periods or user-initiated data or event deletion. The nearby items cover other things: server-side PII scrubbing (title only), US/EU storage location, quota management, and deleting releases. None of these is retention or deletion control, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
